book_name: WFD新版9月虫预测188句 短语速刷

words.tr: phrase. 著名的；备受赞誉的理论
words.ex: Einstein is known for the celebrated theory of relativity.
words.ex_cn: 爱因斯坦因著名的相对论而闻名。
words.en: The well-known and respected theoretical framework.

words.tr: phrase. 一种良好的建筑结构
words.ex: The old church is a good architectural structure.
words.ex_cn: 这座旧教堂是一个很好的建筑结构。
words.en: A good architectural structure: A well-designed and functional building or framework.

words.w: should be useful durable and beautiful
words.tr: adj. 应该是有用的、耐用的且美观的
words.uk: ʃʊd bi ˈjuːsfl ˈdjʊərəbl ənd ˈbjuːtɪfl
words.us: ʃʊd bi ˈjuːsfl ˈdʊrəbl ənd ˈbjuːtɪfl
words.ex: This chair should be useful, durable, and beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子应该实用、耐用且美观。
words.en: Must be practical, long-lasting, and aesthetically pleasing.

words.tr: phrase. 一次小组会议；团体聚会
words.ex: We had a group meeting yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨天开了一个小组会议。
words.en: A gathering of multiple individuals for discussion or collaboration.

words.tr: 短语：将于明天举行
words.ex: The meeting will be held tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 会议将在明天举行。
words.en: Scheduled to occur on the following day.

words.tr: phrase. 在图书馆会议室里
words.ex: The meeting is in the library conference room.
words.ex_cn: 会议在图书馆的会议室举行。
words.en: In the room designated for meetings within a library.

words.w: A number of students have volunteer jobs
words.tr: 短语. 许多学生有志愿者工作
words.uk: ə ˈnʌmbər əv ˈstjuːdənts hæv ˈvɒləntɪə ʤəbz
words.us: ə ˈnʌmbər əv ˈstuden ts hæv ˈvɑːləntɪr ʤəbz
words.ex: A number of students have volunteer jobs at the local library.
words.ex_cn: 一些学生在当地的图书馆做志愿者工作。
words.en: Several students have unpaid work positions, often for community service or experience.

words.tr: 名词短语。教育程度；教育水平
words.ex: His educational level is high school.
words.ex_cn: 他的教育水平是高中。
words.en: The stage or standard of education that a person has achieved.

words.w: is found to be related to
words.tr: phrase. 被发现与…有关；被证实与…相关
words.uk: ɪz faʊnd tə bi rɪˈleɪtɪd tuː
words.us: ɪz faʊnd tə bi rɪˈleɪtɪd tu
words.ex: This disease is found to be related to poor diet.
words.ex_cn: 这种疾病被发现与不良饮食有关。
words.en: Is discovered to have a connection or association with something else.

words.tr: phrase. 社会与经济背景；指影响个人或群体的社会地位和经济状况的综合环境因素
words.ex: Her social and economic background greatly influenced her career choices.
words.ex_cn: 她的社会经济背景极大地影响了她的职业选择。
words.en: The social and economic background refers to the combination of an individual's social status, family income, education level, and other economic factors that influence their life opportunities and choices.

words.w: We can all meet at my office
words.tr: phrase. 我们都可以在我的办公室见面
words.uk: wi kæn ɔːl miːt æt maɪ ˈɒfɪs
words.us: wi kæn ɔːl miːt æt maɪ ˈɔːfɪs
words.ex: We can all meet at my office.
words.ex_cn: 我们都可以在我的办公室见面。
words.en: We can all gather at my place of work.

words.tr: phrase. 在讲座之后
words.ex: We went for coffee after the lecture.
words.ex_cn: 我们在讲座之后去喝了咖啡。
words.en: Following the lecture.

words.tr: 短语：辅导课/教程已被安排（排定）
words.ex: Tutorials are scheduled for every Tuesday.
words.ex_cn: 辅导课安排在每周二。
words.en: Scheduled sessions for instruction or guidance.

words.w: in the final week of the term
words.tr: phrase. phr. 在学期最后一周
words.uk: /ɪn ðə ˈfaɪnəl wiːk əv ðə tɜːm/
words.us: /ɪn ðə ˈfaɪnəl wik əv ðə tɜrm/
words.ex: He finished his homework in the final week of the term.
words.ex_cn: 他在学期的最后一周完成了作业。
words.en: During the last seven days of an academic term.

words.tr: 名词短语。议程项目；会议中需要讨论的各项议题
words.ex: The meeting will discuss three agenda items.
words.ex_cn: 会议将讨论三个议程项目。
words.en: Agenda items are the individual topics or tasks to be discussed or accomplished in a meeting or event.

words.tr: phrase. 应该被提交；应当呈交
words.ex: The report should be submitted by Friday.
words.ex_cn: 报告应该在周五前提交。
words.en: Must be handed in or presented by a specific deadline.

words.w: by the end of the day
words.tr: 短语. 到一天结束时；最迟在今天之内；最终
words.uk: baɪ ði end əv ðə deɪ
words.us: baɪ ði end əv ðə deɪ
words.ex: By the end of the day, he finished his homework.
words.ex_cn: 到一天结束时，他完成了作业。
words.en: Before the day is over; ultimately.

words.tr: phrase. 所有行业
words.ex: All industries need clean water.
words.ex_cn: 所有行业都需要干净的水。
words.en: All industries refers to every sector of economic activity, encompassing manufacturing, services, and other commercial enterprises.

words.tr: 短语，表示“……的系统；……的体系”，用于描述某一类组织、方法或结构的整体安排
words.ex: He solved a system of two equations.
words.ex_cn: 他解了一个由两个方程组成的方程组。
words.en: A set of connected things or parts forming a complex whole.

words.tr: phrase. 输入、处理、输出和反馈（系统或过程的基本组成部分）
words.ex: The machine takes inputs, runs processes, gives outputs, and uses feedback.
words.ex_cn: 机器接收输入，运行处理，输出结果，并使用反馈。
words.en: Inputs, processes, outputs, and feedback.

words.tr: phrase. 所有的作业；全部的任务
words.ex: He finished all of the assignments before the deadline.
words.ex_cn: 他在截止日期前完成了所有作业。
words.en: Every task or piece of work assigned to students.

words.tr: phrase. 必须被提交的
words.ex_cn: 作业必须在周五前提交。
words.en: Required to be presented or handed in by a specified time.

words.w: in person to the faculty office
words.tr: phr. 亲自前往院系办公室
words.uk: ɪn ˈpɜːsn tə ðə ˈfæklti ˈɒfɪs
words.us: ɪn ˈpɜːrsən tə ðə ˈfækəlti ˈɔːfɪs
words.ex: He went in person to the faculty office to ask for help.
words.ex_cn: 他亲自去教工办公室寻求帮助。
words.en: Face-to-face at the office of the teaching staff.

words.tr: phrase. 经济发展
words.ex: The country wants economic development to help its people.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家希望经济发展来帮助人民。
words.en: Economic development refers to the process by which the economic well-being and quality of life of a nation, region, or local community are improved according to targeted goals and objectives.

words.tr: phrase. 你所有的作业或任务
words.ex: You must finish all of your assignments before Friday.
words.ex_cn: 你必须在周五之前完成所有的作业。
words.en: All of your assignments: Every piece of work or task given to you to complete.

words.tr: 短语. 应在明天之前完成或到期
words.ex: The homework are due by tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 作业必须在明天之前交。
words.en: Must be completed or submitted by the day after today.

words.w: All students are expected to attend
words.tr: phr. 所有学生都被要求出席
words.uk: ɔːl ˈstjuːdənts ɑːr ɪkˈspektɪd tə əˈtend
words.us: ɔːl ˈstuːdənts ɑːr ɪkˈspektɪd tə əˈtend
words.ex: All students are expected to attend the math class.
words.ex_cn: 所有学生都被要求参加数学课。
words.en: Every student is required to be present.

words.tr: n. 每学期十次实验课
words.ex: There are ten lab sessions per semester.
words.ex_cn: 每个学期有十次实验课。
words.en: Ten practical sessions in a laboratory each academic term.

words.tr: v. 留下贵重物品；把贵重物品留在某处
words.ex: He forgot by leaving valuable possessions in the car.
words.ex_cn: 他忘了把贵重物品留在车里。
words.en: Departing from a place while leaving behind valuable items, often unintentionally.

words.w: unattended in public place is risky
words.tr: adj. 无人看管的；在公共场所无人照看的
words.ex: Leaving your bag unattended in public place is risky.
words.ex_cn: 把包单独留在公共场所是有风险的。
words.en: Leaving something unattended in a public place is dangerous and may lead to theft or damage.

words.tr: phr. 大多数科学家认为……
words.ex: Most scientists believe that climate change is real.
words.ex_cn: 大多数科学家认为气候变化是真实的。
words.en: The majority of scientists hold the view that something is true or will happen.

words.w: climate change threatens the lives on earth
words.tr: phr. 气候变化威胁着地球上的生命
words.uk: ˈklaɪmət tʃeɪndʒ ˈθretns ðə laɪvz ɒn ɜːθ
words.us: ˈklaɪmət tʃeɪndʒ ˈθretns ðə laɪvz ɑːn ɜːrθ
words.ex: Climate change threatens the lives on earth.
words.ex_cn: 气候变化威胁着地球上的生命。
words.en: Global warming poses a significant danger to the survival of living beings on our planet.

words.tr: phrase. 美国人通常定义无中文释义
words.ex: Americans have typically defined success as hard work and money.
words.ex_cn: 美国人通常将成功定义为努力工作和金钱。
words.en: People from the United States have commonly characterized or understood.

words.tr: phrase. 植物生长的过程
words.ex: The process of plant growth takes many weeks.
words.ex_cn: 植物生长的过程需要很多周。
words.en: The series of changes that a plant undergoes from the beginning of its life until it reaches maturity, involving cell division, elongation, and differentiation.

words.tr: phrase. 在数量上；从数量角度；以量化方式
words.ex: We measured the growth in quantitative terms.
words.ex_cn: 我们用数量术语来衡量增长。
words.en: Expressed or measured using numbers, statistics, or numerical data rather than qualitative descriptions.

words.tr: phrase. 介绍；引言；入门
words.ex: He gave an introduction to the new project.
words.ex_cn: 他对新项目做了一个介绍。
words.en: A preliminary section or part of a book, speech, or course that introduces the main subject.

words.tr: phrase. 演示中的一个必要组成部分；展示中不可或缺的要素
words.ex: Eye contact is an essential element of presentation.
words.ex_cn: 眼神交流是演讲的一个关键要素。
words.en: A fundamental component required for an effective presentation.

words.tr: phrase. 在那方面；关于这一点
words.ex: He failed the test, and in that regard, he needs to study more.
words.ex_cn: 他考试没及格，在这方面，他需要多学习。
words.en: Concerning this specific point

words.w: as well as in other regards
words.tr: prep. 在其他方面也；同样在其他方面
words.uk: æz wel æz ɪn ˈʌðə rɪˈɡɑːdz
words.us: æz wel æz ɪn ˈʌðər rɪˈɡɑːrdz
words.ex: He speaks French well, as well as in other regards.
words.ex_cn: 他法语说得好，其他方面也是如此。
words.en: In this particular area and in other areas

words.w: it stands as an important contribution
words.tr: phr. 它被视为一项重要贡献；它作为一项重要贡献屹立不倒
words.uk: ɪt stændz æz ən ɪmˈpɔːtnt ˌkɒntrɪˈbjuːʃn
words.us: ɪt stændz æz ən ɪmˈpɔːrtnt ˌkɑːntrɪˈbjuːʃn
words.ex: It stands as an important contribution to science.
words.ex_cn: 它作为对科学的重要贡献而存在。
words.en: It stands as an important contribution: It is considered a significant addition to a field of study or discussion.

words.w: The assignments should be submitted to
words.tr: 短语 作业应提交至……
words.uk: ðə əˈsaɪnmənts ʃʊd bi səbˈmɪtɪd tuː
words.us: ðiː əˈsaɪnmənts ʃʊd bi səbˈmɪtɪd tuː
words.ex: The assignments should be submitted to the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 作业应该提交给老师。
words.en: Work or tasks must be handed in to a person or department for assessment.

words.tr: phrase. 部门办公室
words.ex: I went to the department office to ask for help.
words.ex_cn: 我去系办公室寻求帮助。
words.en: The administrative office of a specific department within an organization.

words.tr: phrase. 在截止日期之前
words.ex: He finished his homework before the deadlines.
words.ex_cn: 他在截止日期前完成了作业。
words.en: Prior to the deadlines; in advance of the set time limits.

words.tr: phrase. 学生将建立自信
words.ex: Students will develop confidence by practicing math every day.
words.ex_cn: 学生通过每天练习数学来建立信心。
words.en: Learners will gain self-assurance and belief in their own abilities.

words.tr: phrase. 在他们做……的能力方面；在他们具备做……的能力上
words.ex: Children are improving in their ability to solve math problems.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在解决数学问题的能力上有所提高。
words.en: Regarding their capacity or skill to do something.

words.tr: phrase. 批判性地思考；审慎分析与评估地思考
words.ex: He thinks critically about every problem.
words.ex_cn: 他对每个问题都进行批判性思考。
words.en: To think critically means to analyze facts to form a judgment. It involves the objective analysis and evaluation of an issue in order to form a judgment.

words.tr: 短语. 仍然是……的来源
words.ex: The river is still the source of water for the village.
words.ex_cn: 这条河仍然是村庄水源的来源。
words.en: Continuing to be the origin or cause of something.

words.tr: phrase. 重大的争议；激烈的争论
words.ex: There is great controversy about the new law.
words.ex_cn: 关于这项新法律，存在巨大争议。
words.en: A great controversy refers to a significant and often heated dispute or debate over a particular issue.

words.tr: phrase. 需要被支持；需要得到支持；必须被支撑
words.ex: The child needs to be supported by his parents.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子需要父母的支持。
words.en: Requires evidence, justification, or backing to be considered valid or effective.

words.tr: phrase. 由政府
words.ex: The project was funded by the government.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目由政府资助。
words.en: by the national governing authority

words.tr: phrase. 某些科学原理
words.ex: These certain scientific principles explain how plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 这些某些科学原理解释了植物是如何生长的。
words.en: Fundamental and established truths or rules in the field of science.

words.tr: phrase. 必须被学会的；需要掌握的
words.ex: This rule must be learned by all students.
words.ex_cn: 这个规则必须被所有学生学会。
words.en: Necessary to acquire knowledge or skill through study or experience.

words.tr: phrase. 通过口头表达或通过逻辑推理的方式
words.ex: He solved the puzzle verbally or by logical deduction.
words.ex_cn: 他通过口头说明或逻辑推理解决了这个谜题。
words.en: Using spoken words or through reasoned, step-by-step argument.

words.w: Climate change is now an acceptable phenomenon
words.tr: n. 气候变化现在已被视为一种可接受的现象
words.uk: ˈklaɪmət tʃeɪndʒ ɪz naʊ ən əkˈseptəbl fəˈnɒmɪnən
words.us: ˈklaɪmət tʃeɪndʒ ɪz naʊ ən əkˈseptəbl fəˈnɑːmɪnɑːn
words.ex: Climate change is now an acceptable phenomenon.
words.ex_cn: 气候变化现在是一个被接受的现象。
words.en: Global warming is now widely accepted as a real and occurring event.

words.w: among a group of reputable scientists
words.tr: prep. 在一群声誉卓著的科学家之中
words.uk: əˈmʌŋ ə ɡruːp əv ˈrepjətəbl ˈsaɪəntɪsts
words.us: əˈmʌŋ ə ɡruːp əv ˈrepjətəbl ˈsaɪəntɪsts
words.ex: He presented his findings among a group of reputable scientists.
words.ex_cn: 他在一群声誉良好的科学家面前展示了他的研究结果。
words.en: Within a group of experts who are respected and trusted in their field.

words.tr: n. 护理临床实习安排；在护理专业中，学生被安排到医院或其他医疗机构进行实践学习的阶段
words.ex: Nursing students do clinical placements in hospitals.
words.ex_cn: 护理专业的学生在医院进行临床实习。
words.en: Practical, hands-on training periods for nursing students in healthcare settings.

words.tr: prep. 为学生做好准备；使学生适应（某事，如考试、工作等）
words.ex: The teacher prepares students for the math test.
words.ex_cn: 老师为学生准备数学考试。
words.en: To equip or train students with the skills and knowledge needed for future challenges or careers.

words.tr: phrase. 专业实践；职业实务；行业惯例
words.ex: Engaging in professional practice requires continuous learning and adaptation.
words.ex_cn: 从事专业实践需要持续学习和适应。
words.en: Professional practice refers to the application of professional knowledge and skills in a real-world setting, often within a specific profession or field.

words.tr: phrase. 消费者信心；指消费者对经济形势、就业和收入前景的乐观或悲观程度
words.ex: Consumer confidence is high after the economy improved.
words.ex_cn: 经济改善后，消费者信心很高。
words.en: Consumer confidence refers to the degree of optimism that consumers feel about the overall state of the economy and their personal financial situation. How confident people feel about stability of their incomes determines their spending activity and therefore serves as one of the key indicators for the overall shape of the economy.

words.w: has a direct influence on sales
words.tr: phrase. 对销售额产生直接影响
words.uk: hæz ə dɪˈrekt ˈɪnfluəns ɒn seɪlz
words.us: hæz ə dəˈrekt ˈɪnfluəns ɑn seɪlz
words.ex: The weather has a direct influence on sales.
words.ex_cn: 天气直接影响销售。
words.en: Has a noticeable and immediate effect on the volume of goods sold.

words.tr: phrase. + n. 令人信服的证据；能够使人相信某事真实性的证据
words.ex: The lawyer presented convincing evidence that the defendant was innocent.
words.ex_cn: 律师提出了令人信服的证据，证明被告是无辜的。
words.en: Evidence that is so strong and clear that it makes you believe that something is true or exists.

words.w: to support this theory is hard to obtain
words.tr: phr. 难以获得支持这一理论的证据；要找到支持该理论的依据很困难
words.uk: tə səˈpɔːt ðɪs ˈθɪəri ɪz hɑːd tə əbˈteɪn
words.us: tu səˈpɔːrt ðɪs ˈθiːəri ɪz hɑːrd tə əbˈteɪn
words.ex: To support this theory is hard to obtain.
words.ex_cn: 要支持这个理论很难获得证据。
words.en: Evidence to back up this theory is difficult to find.

words.tr: phrase. 经济状况；经济地位
words.ex: The economic status of his family changed after he got a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他找到新工作后，家里的经济状况发生了变化。
words.en: The financial condition or standing of an economy.

words.tr: phrase. 关于早期罗马共和国的
words.ex: The laws of the early Roman republic were simple and strict.
words.ex_cn: 早期罗马共和国的法律简单而严格。
words.en: Relating to the initial period of the Roman state, before the Empire.

words.tr: phrase. 将被检查；将被审查；将被考试（被动语态结构）
words.ex: The results will be examined by the doctor tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 医生明天会检查这些结果。
words.en: Will be examined means that something is scheduled or expected to be looked at or inspected in the future.

words.tr: phrase. 学术实力；学术优势
words.ex: The academic strength of this school is its science program.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校的学术优势是它的科学课程。
words.en: The intellectual rigor or quality of academic work.

words.tr: phr. 明天的讲座已被取消
words.ex: Tomorrow's lecture has been canceled.
words.ex_cn: 明天的讲座被取消了。
words.en: The lecture scheduled for tomorrow has been called off.

words.tr: 由于停电
words.ex: The lights went out due to the power cut.
words.ex_cn: 由于停电，灯灭了。
words.en: Because of the power outage.

words.tr: phrase. 找到一份工作；成功获得职位
words.ex: He landed a job at a local store.
words.ex_cn: 他得到了一份在当地商店的工作。
words.en: He secured a job.

words.w: in a very prestigious law firm
words.tr: phrase. 在一家极具声望的律师事务所
words.ex: He works in a very prestigious law firm.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家非常著名的律师事务所工作。
words.en: Working within a highly respected and influential legal practice.

words.tr: adj. 享有声望的；声望很高的；
words.ex: He got into a prestigious university.
words.ex_cn: 他进入了一所享有声望的大学。
words.en: A prestigious institution, job, or activity is respected and admired because it is considered to be of very high quality.

words.w: Many birds migrate to warmer areas
words.tr: phr. 许多鸟类迁徙到更温暖的地区
